# Supporting VT100 construction reference

Wolfgang Stief, *DEC VT100*, 2014-10-04. [Commons source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:DEC_VT100_%2815272092560%29.jpg); [photographer original](https://www.flickr.com/photos/stiefkind/15272092560/); [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en). The original bytes match the published SHA-1; hashes and raw metadata are retained.

Green screen text and a visible VT100 badge support device construction, but the partly covered glass, brightly lit cream case and surrounding desk do not establish a dark room or screen-only desk spill. Retained as a supporting reference outside required slots. This file does not fill terminal slot 3, which still needs green phosphor in a dark room with desk-confined screen light. The lit case, keyboard blocks, glass recess and badge may inform construction; they are not measured lighting or a shipped texture.
